feeds.title: Daily Tarot Girl
feeds.description: Founded by Kate, a professional Tarot reader, in 2011, Daily Tarot Girl Blog offers daily Tarot insights, practical tips, and guidance for readers of all levels. Their mission is to demystify Tarot and empower individuals to connect with their intuition. Visit their website to explore their blog and unlock the wisdom of Tarot.

feeds.title: ETHONY Blog
feeds.description: ETHONY is a Tarot reader, author, and founder of The Tarot Readers Academy. Their blog, established in 2012, provides a wealth of Tarot knowledge, including card interpretations, Tarot spreads, and insightful articles on Tarot practice and mysticism. Immerse yourself in the world of Tarot by visiting their website and exploring their blog.

feeds.title: Stafford Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Stafford Tarot Blog, created by Jane Stafford, is a treasure trove of Tarot wisdom and inspiration. Established in 2008, the blog features card interpretations, Tarot spreads, and reflections on Tarot as a spiritual practice. Explore their website to enrich your Tarot journey and delve into the depths of Stafford Tarot Blog.

feeds.title: Svetarot Blog
feeds.description: Svetarot is a Tarot blog dedicated to providing guidance, inspiration, and resources for Tarot enthusiasts. Founded by Elena in 2015, their blog offers card interpretations, Tarot spreads, and articles on Tarot symbolism and divination. Immerse yourself in the wisdom of Tarot by visiting their website and exploring the Svetarot Blog.

feeds.title: Liz Worth's Tarot Blog
feeds.description: Liz Worth, a Tarot reader and author, shares her Tarot expertise and musings through her blog. Founded in 2010, Liz Worth's Tarot Blog offers a mix of practical Tarot tips, card explorations, and reflections on Tarot as a tool for personal transformation. Visit her website to dive into the realm of Tarot and discover Liz's unique insights.

feeds.title: Psychic Tarot Reader Kathleen Meadows
feeds.description: Kathleen Meadows is a renowned psychic and Tarot reader who shares her wisdom and intuitive insights through her blog. With years of experience, Kathleen offers a unique perspective on Tarot and its connection to personal growth and spiritual development. Visit her website to discover Kathleen's profound teachings and gain a deeper understanding of the Tarot.
